defmodule ChatServer.Encryption do @iv_length 16 # Resolve the AES-256-GCM key at RUNTIME from secure configuration/environment, # never bake it into the compiled artifact as a module attribute. defp aes_key do key = Application.get_env(:chat_server, :aes_key) || System.get_env("CHAT_SERVER_AES_KEY") case key do raw when is_binary(raw) and byte_size(raw) == 32 -> raw encoded when is_binary(encoded) -> case Base.decode64(encoded) do {:ok, decoded} when byte_size(decoded) == 32 -> decoded _ -> raise "Invalid CHAT_SERVER_AES_KEY: must be 32 raw bytes or base64 encoding thereof" end _ -> raise "Missing encryption key: configure :chat_server, :aes_key or CHAT_SERVER_AES_KEY" end end def encrypt(plaintext) when is_binary(plaintext) do iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@iv_length) {ciphertext, tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead( :aes_256_gcm, aes_key(), iv, plaintext, "", true ) Base.encode64(iv <> tag <> ciphertext) end def decrypt(encoded) when is_binary(encoded) do case Base.decode64(encoded) do {:ok, <>} -> case :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead( :aes_256_gcm, aes_key(), iv, ciphertext, "", tag, false ) do plaintext when is_binary(plaintext) -> {:ok, plaintext} :error -> {:error, :decryption_failed} end _ -> {:error, :invalid_format} end end end defmodule ChatServer.Sanitizer do @doc """ Sanitizes user input for safe HTML rendering.
